title: A process for preparation of standardized extract from Withania somnifera with enhanced withanolide glycosides content
text: BACKGROUND: Traditional churna powders contain low (0.2-0.5%) active withanolides and vary widely between agricultural batches. Furthermore, withaferin A at high concentrations exhibits cytotoxic rather than adaptogenic properties. The present process selectively enriches withanolide glycosides while depleting cytotoxic aglycones.
